{
  "categories": [
    {
      "name": "docs",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Documentation updates in doc/assumeutxo.md and release notes follow directly from the code changes.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Not docs membership because documentation edits merely document the change in assumeutxo startup behavior."
    },
    {
      "name": "indexes",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Only touches src/index/base.cpp (+1/-1) as a mechanical follow-up.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "The one-line edit in base.cpp is incidental to the node startup changes and does not alter index behavior or synchronization."
    },
    {
      "name": "mempool",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Touches src/validation.cpp to remove runtime mempool coordination when loading snapshots, but does not modify mempool policy or structure.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "The change removes assumeutxo runtime interaction with the mempool by moving snapshot loading to startup; it does not change mempool rules or logic."
    },
    {
      "name": "p2p",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Removes runtime local network service demotion (RemoveLocalServices) in net.h, but the change is primarily validation startup sequencing.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Deleting dynamic service flag demotion follows directly from loading the snapshot before network initialization rather than modifying P2P protocols or connection handling."
    },
    {
      "name": "rpc",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Retires the public `loadtxoutset` RPC in src/rpc/blockchain.cpp (+9/-79), converting it into a hidden RPC for fuzzing.",
      "band": "P3",
      "score": 0.4,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Retiring the public `loadtxoutset` RPC alters public interface compatibility and changes the assumeutxo workflow. Because this deprecates an RPC endpoint in favor of a startup argument without altering other RPC machinery, it is a straightforward interface cleanup."
    },
    {
      "name": "tests",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Modifies functional tests and fuzz harnesses specifically to adapt them to the assumeutxo startup flag.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0,
      "reason_tag": "test coverage",
      "rationale": "Updates to feature_assumeutxo.py and fuzz harnesses follow the validation changes and do not alter general test infrastructure."
    },
    {
      "name": "tools",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Only updates bash completion in contrib/completions/bash/bitcoind.bash (+1/-1).",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "The one-line bash completion update is a mechanical consequence of adding a command-line option."
    },
    {
      "name": "utils",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Modifies src/init.cpp (+58/-4) to parse the `-loadtxoutset` flag and sequence snapshot loading.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Argument and init sequencing changes whose sole purpose is one subsystem's behavior belong to that subsystem rather than utils."
    },
    {
      "name": "validation",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Heavily modifies assumeutxo snapshot loading in src/validation.cpp, src/validation.h, and src/node/utxo_snapshot.cpp.",
      "band": "P2",
      "score": 0.65,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Moving snapshot loading to node startup eliminates significant architectural hazards in chainstate management. As stated in the description, loading at runtime required 'coordinating with an active mempool, dynamic validation cache rebalancing and flushing, demoting advertised network services on active connections, and defending against race conditions from concurrent block arrivals'; resolving these simplifies validation invariants and cache management substantially."
    },
    {
      "name": "wallet",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Touches only test/functional/wallet_assumeutxo.py to update its assumeutxo test setup.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "The PR does not modify bitcoind wallet code or wallet interfaces."
    }
  ],
  "factors": {
    "security_stability": 1,
    "bug_severity": 0,
    "performance": 1,
    "user_value": 1,
    "leverage": 2
  }
}
